description: This source file defines a base class for managing test clusters with default configurations in Orleans testing framework, along with extension methods for serialization, deep copying, and serializer retrieval related to testing clusters.

classes.name: HostedTestClusterEnsureDefaultStarted
classes.description: Abstract base class ensuring an Orleans test silo cluster is started with default configuration and manages reference to the cluster and its services.

methods.name: RoundTripSystemTextJsonSerialization
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a value using System.Text.Json to test serialization integrity.

methods.name: RoundTripSerializationForTesting
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes a value using Orleans Serializer for testing purposes.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a value using Orleans DeepCopier service.

methods.name: GetSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves the Orleans Serializer service from the cluster's service provider.
